intuition: A duplicate exists exactly when a value is encountered a second time. A set records which values have already appeared.

brute_force.approach: Compare every pair of values and return true when two are equal.

optimal.approach: Insert values into a set while scanning; a value already in the set proves a duplicate.

edge_cases: An empty or one-element input has no duplicate.
Negative values and repeated values are handled the same way as positive values.
